Thanks again for the walkthrough last week — Ben and I are excited to evaluate Redwood for a short pilot around our search-relevance use case. We were aiming to run a 2-week pilot starting the week of Apr 19 so we could evaluate results ahead of our planning window.

Would you be able to hold the slot? If needed I can propose a tentative window post-review (earliest May 3). If Redwood prefers to keep the current tentative time and we confirm after Apr 15, that works too — we want to avoid ghosting.

I've attached the internal budget workbook so you see how they're tracking the pilot spend (FYI).
